children: Overview
Sweden-based digital consultancy's Q3 revenue rose, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITA margin for Q3 was 6.7%
Profitability improved despite fewer employees; Norway and Products unit performed strongly
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
Knowit expects continued challenges in Sweden and Finland due to market conditions
Result Drivers
ORGANIZATIONAL RESTRUCTURING - Co said it is moving to a simpler, more cost-effective country-based structure to reduce complexity and be closer to clients
PRODUCTS UNIT PERFORMANCE - Products business area delivered both growth and improved profitability, supported by in-house platforms and IP-based consultancy services

MARKET VARIATION - Co said performance varied across markets, with Norway showing strong development, Sweden facing challenges in utilization and adaptation, and Finland experiencing the most difficult market due to a weaker economic climate
